units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 56a:9">Snh. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ דסכינא</he> the sharp edge of the knife.
Ab. Zar. 39ᵃ חוּרְפָּהּ דחלתיתא (not פיה …) the pungency of assa foetida; a. fr.—Trnsf. acumen, ingenuity.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 96b:2">B. Mets. 96ᵇ</cite> <he>לפום ח׳ וכ׳</he> as great as a man’s ingenuity, is the mistake he makes; <cite ref="Niddah 33b:3">Nidd. 33ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Eruvin 90a:3">Erub. 90ᵃ</cite> <he>אגב חוּרְפֵּיה לא וכ׳</he> relying on his ingenuity he did not study it carefully; <cite ref="Bava Batra 116b:1">B. Bath. 116ᵇ</cite>.—Pl. <he>חוּרְפֵּי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 19:16">Targ. Y. Lev. XIX, 16</cite> <he>תרין חוּרְפּוֹי</he> its double edge.
